description: Pause up to 100 monitors in one call, all or nothing: no checks run and each open incident closes without an alert. Use it to stop monitoring a whole project or group found with list_monitors; for one monitor use pause_monitor, and to silence alerts around a deploy while checks keep running use create_maintenance_window instead. Requires a key with the write scope. Pausing a paused monitor is not an error. Returns monitors: the list_monitors rows after the change, in request order. Example: {"monitor_ids": ["<id from list_monitors>", "<id from list_monitors>"]}

monitor_ids.description: 1 to 100 distinct monitor uuids from list_monitors. A repeated id is a 422; an id that is not a monitor of this organization is a 404 naming it, and then nothing changes.

name: bulk_pause_monitors

status.description: Known values: PENDING, UP, DEGRADED, DOWN, PAUSED.

type.description: Known values: HTTP, PING, SSL, TCP, DNS.

title: Pause many monitors
